question: The levonorgestrel intrauterine system (LNG-IUS / Mirena) is the most effective medical (non-surgical) treatment for heavy menstrual bleeding, reducing blood loss by up to 90%.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. The LNG-IUS reduces blood loss by 80–90% — significantly more than oral hormonal treatments such as combined OCP or tranexamic acid. NICE and WHO guidelines support it as first-line medical therapy for HMB.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. The LNG-IUS (Mirena, 52 mg levonorgestrel) reduces menstrual blood loss by 80–90% through local progestogenic endometrial suppression. It is now recommended as the first-line medical treatment for HMB in women who do not desire immediate fertility.
